dct_title_s: Papua New Guinea - Earthquake on Dec 22 2025
dct_description_sm: **ADAM ID: **[sm\_us6000rwgh](https://api.adam.geospatial.wfp.org/api/collections/adam.adam_eq_events/items?uid=sm_us6000rwgh) Magnitude 6.5 earthquake at 110.18 depth occurred on Dec 22 2025 15km NE of Brahman. The epicentre of the earthquake was located at latitude -5.7199 longitude 145.4955. It impacted 310188 people within 50km. WFP’s Automated Disaster Analysis and Mapping (ADAM) system is an operational system for collecting, analysing and mapping geospatial and socio-economic information following sudden onset humanitarian emergencies.
